notes: Changed: Data Breach — Locked Nodes deeper into the world now take more than one clear to fully breach (Frostbyte Tundra and the Undergrid need 2, Overclocked Foundry and the Ghost Server need 3; the first two biomes are unchanged at 1). Every stage is the same difficulty, just more of them — a failed attempt only retries that stage, no progress lost. The full reward — Bits, capture programs, and the Network Access Key on your first breach in a biome — pays out on the final clear, scaled up to match the extra effort.
